title: Loomground token
description: The unit of data that flows along a cord (specification, The token).

id.description: identity; guards never range over it

kind.description: class of the subject or action, matched against declarations; host-observed at the tool-call/effect boundary — derived from the operation actually performed as the host sees it, never asserted or declared by the acting actor

risk.description: ordered severity level; gate-computed from a governed, versioned, signed policy table, then carried on the token. A self-declared value is advisory only, admitted solely as a monotonic ratchet — it may raise the computed tier, never lower it, and is never itself authoritative

party.description: the party currently responsible (a subject identity)

provenance.description: ordered prior nodes and parties traversed

reversibility.description: ordered declared property: how recoverable the effect is once released. Asserted by whoever supplies the token; never derived

uncertainty.description: ordered declared property: how settled the basis for the action is, orthogonal to merit. Asserted by whoever supplies the token; never inferred

tags.description: declared, non-id categories a guard may test by membership (origin, lineage, synthetic, taint); the tag vocabulary is policy
